class Watch(Base):
    def test_scheduled_debit_requires_date_and_account(self):
        with self.assertRaises(VaultError):
            self.v.add_scheduled_debit("d1", "Merchant", "10.00", due_date="", account="cash_app")
        with self.assertRaises(VaultError):
            self.v.add_scheduled_debit("d1", "Merchant", "10.00", due_date="2026-11-02", account="")
        oid = self.v.add_scheduled_debit("d1", "Merchant", "10.00", due_date="2026-11-02", account="cash_app")
        [o] = self.v.obligations()
        self.assertEqual((o["id"], o["kind"], o["due_date"], o["account"]),
                         (oid, "scheduled_debit", "2026-11-02", "cash_app"))

    def test_watch_window_includes_overdue_and_7d_excludes_8d_and_undated(self):
        self.v.set_balance("cash_app", "292.00", "2026-10-30")
        self.v.add_scheduled_debit("a", "Soon", "50.00", due_date="2026-11-02", account="cash_app")
        self.v.add_scheduled_debit("b", "Late", "10.00", due_date="2026-10-28", account="cash_app")
        self.v.add_scheduled_debit("c", "Far", "10.00", due_date="2026-11-07", account="cash_app")
        self.v.add_obligation("u", "Undated debit", "10.00", account="cash_app", kind="scheduled_debit")
        rows = rules.debit_watch(self.v.snapshot(), TODAY)
        self.assertEqual([r["payee"] for r in rows], ["Late", "Soon"])
        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["when"], "OVERDUE 2d")

    def test_watch_cumulative_coverage_runs_out_in_due_order(self):
        self.v.set_balance("cash_app", "100.00", "2026-10-30")
        self.v.add_scheduled_debit("a", "First", "60.00", due_date="2026-11-01", account="cash_app")
        self.v.add_scheduled_debit("b", "Second", "60.00", due_date="2026-11-03", account="cash_app")
        rows = rules.debit_watch(self.v.snapshot(), TODAY)
        self.assertEqual([(r["payee"], r["covered"], r["shortfall_cents"]) for r in rows],
                         [("First", True, 0), ("Second", False, 2000)])

    def test_watch_unknown_balance_is_none_not_a_guess(self):
        self.v.add_scheduled_debit("a", "Mystery", "10.00", due_date="2026-11-01", account="chime")
        [row] = rules.debit_watch(self.v.snapshot(), TODAY)
        self.assertIsNone(row["covered"])
        self.assertIsNone(row["shortfall_cents"])

    def test_deficit_guard_extended_to_dated_debits(self):
        # The $292 case shape: a dated debit larger than the balance flags DEFICIT,
        # and the same debit lands in the board's 7-day watch.
        self.v.set_balance("cash_app", "292.00", "2026-10-30")
        self.v.add_scheduled_debit("live", "Unknown merchant debit", "310.00",
                                   due_date="2026-11-04", account="cash_app")
        flags = rules.deficit_guard(self.v.snapshot(), TODAY)
        self.assertEqual([(f["level"], f["account"], f["shortfall_cents"]) for f in flags],
                         [("DEFICIT", "cash_app", 1800)])
        b = rules.board(self.v.snapshot(), TODAY)
        self.assertEqual([r["payee"] for r in b["debit_watch"]], ["Unknown merchant debit"])
        self.assertFalse(b["debit_watch"][0]["covered"])

    def test_due_window_lists_bills_and_debits_within_7d(self):
        self.v.add_obligation("bill", "Electric", "40.00", due_date="2026-11-05", account="chime")
        self.v.add_obligation("far", "Far bill", "40.00", due_date="2026-12-01", account="chime")
        rows = rules.due_window(self.v.snapshot(), TODAY)
        self.assertEqual([r["payee"] for r in rows], ["Electric"])

class SweepCards(Base):
    def test_cash_app_source_card_carries_fee_warning_and_math(self):
        self.v.set_balance("robinhood", "0", "2026-10-30")
        self.v.set_balance("cash_app", "100.00", "2026-10-30")
        self.v.add_scheduled_debit("rh", "Robinhood debit", "5.00", due_date="2026-11-01", account="robinhood")
        [card] = rules.sweep_suggestions(self.v.snapshot(), TODAY)
        self.assertEqual(card["status"], rules.PREPARED)
        self.assertEqual(card["rank"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(card["due_by"], "2026-11-01")
        self.assertIn("$5.00 short", card["math"])
        self.assertIn("$100.00 balance", card["math"])
        self.assertIn("fee preview in the Cash App app", card["fee_warning"])
        self.assertNotIn("%", card["fee_warning"])  # the fee itself is never stated or guessed

    def test_non_cash_app_source_has_no_cash_app_warning(self):
        self.v.set_balance("robinhood", "0", "2026-10-30")
        self.v.set_balance("chime", "100.00", "2026-10-30")
        self.v.add_scheduled_debit("rh", "Robinhood debit", "5.00", due_date="2026-11-01", account="robinhood")
        [card] = rules.sweep_suggestions(self.v.snapshot(), TODAY)
        self.assertEqual(card["from"], "chime")
        self.assertNotIn("fee_warning", card)

    def test_cards_ranked_by_earliest_due_then_shortfall(self):
        self.v.set_balance("cash_app", "500.00", "2026-10-30")
        self.v.set_balance("chime", "0", "2026-10-30")
        self.v.set_balance("robinhood", "0", "2026-10-30")
        self.v.add_scheduled_debit("late", "Late big", "50.00", due_date="2026-11-10", account="robinhood")
        self.v.add_scheduled_debit("early", "Early small", "5.00", due_date="2026-11-01", account="chime")
        cards = rules.sweep_suggestions(self.v.snapshot(), TODAY)
        self.assertEqual([(c["rank"], c["to"]) for c in cards], [(1, "chime"), (2, "robinhood")])

    def test_phase2_computation_writes_nothing(self):
        self.v.set_balance("cash_app", "292.00", "2026-10-30")
        self.v.set_balance("robinhood", "0", "2026-10-30")
        self.v.add_scheduled_debit("rh", "Robinhood debit", "5.00", due_date="2026-11-01", account="robinhood")
        self.v.add_obligation("t", "Talkiatry", "100.00", notice="final notice")
        before = self.state()
        snap = self.v.snapshot()
        b = rules.board(snap, TODAY)
        d = rules.daily_digest(snap, TODAY)
        comp = parking.parking_comparison(snap, parking.load_options(None), TODAY)
        board.render_text(b)
        board.render_html(b)
        board.render_digest({**d, "parking": comp})
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            main(["--db", str(self.path), "digest", "--today", "2026-10-30"])
            main(["--db", str(self.path), "parking", "--today", "2026-10-30"])
        self.assertEqual(self.state(), before)  # no entry, no audit record, no transfer
        self.assertTrue(self.v.verify_audit()["ok"])

class ParkingOptions(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_defaults_are_held_first_and_all_unverified(self):
        opts = parking.load_options(None)
        self.assertTrue(all(o["held"] for o in opts))
        self.assertTrue(all(o["apy_percent"] is None for o in opts))
        self.assertEqual(opts[0]["account_slug"], "cash_app")

    def test_unverified_rate_shows_no_figure_and_no_projection(self):
        v = Vault(":memory:")
        try:
            v.add_account("cash_app", "Cash App", "cash_app")
            v.set_balance("cash_app", "1000.00", "2026-10-30")
            comp = parking.parking_comparison(v.snapshot(), parking.load_options(None), TODAY)
            self.assertIsNone(comp["best_verified"])
            row = next(r for r in comp["rows"] if r["account_slug"] == "cash_app")
            self.assertEqual(row["rate_status"], "UNVERIFIED")
            self.assertIsNone(row["apy_percent"])
            self.assertIsNone(row["projected_annual_cents"])
        finally:
            v.close()

    def test_record_verified_rate_requires_official_source_and_real_date(self):
        opts = parking.load_options(None)
        for bad in ({"source": "http://example.com/rates"}, {"source": "a blog post"},
                    {"checked": "2026-11-01"}, {"checked": "not-a-date"}):
            kw = {"name": "Cash App Savings", "apy_percent": "4.00",
                  "source": "https://cash.app/help", "checked": "2026-10-30"}
            kw.update(bad)
            with self.assertRaises(VaultError, msg=str(bad)):
                parking.record_verified_rate(opts, kw.pop("name"), kw.pop("apy_percent"),
                                             kw.pop("source"), kw.pop("checked"), TODAY)
        out = parking.record_verified_rate(opts, "Cash App Savings", "4.00",
                                           "https://cash.app/help", "2026-10-29", TODAY)
        self.assertIsNone(opts[0]["apy_percent"])  # input not mutated
        self.assertEqual(out[0]["rate_checked"], "2026-10-29")

    def test_verified_rate_projects_on_idle_only_and_goes_stale(self):
        v = Vault(":memory:")
        try:
            v.add_account("cash_app", "Cash App", "cash_app")
            v.set_balance("cash_app", "1000.00", "2026-10-30")
            v.add_scheduled_debit("d", "Due soon", "200.00", due_date="2026-11-05", account="cash_app")
            opts = parking.record_verified_rate(parking.load_options(None), "Cash App Savings",
                                                "5.00", "https://cash.app/help", "2026-10-30", TODAY)
            comp = parking.parking_comparison(v.snapshot(), opts, TODAY)
            row = comp["rows"][0]
            self.assertEqual(comp["best_verified"], "Cash App Savings")
            self.assertEqual(row["idle_cents"], 80000)  # $1000 - $200 due, $0 buffer
            self.assertEqual(row["projected_annual_cents"], 4000)  # $800 x 5% = $40.00
            stale = parking.parking_comparison(v.snapshot(), opts, date(2026, 12, 15))
            self.assertEqual(stale["rows"][0]["rate_status"], "STALE")
            self.assertIsNone(stale["rows"][0]["projected_annual_cents"])
            self.assertIsNone(stale["best_verified"])
        finally:
            v.close()

class CliPhase2(Base):
    def run_cli(self, *args):
        out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
            code = main(["--db", str(self.path), *args])
        return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()

    def test_add_debit_and_digest_end_to_end(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli("seed-known")[0], 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli("set-balance", "cash_app", "292.00", "--as-of", "2026-10-30")[0], 0)
        code, _, err = self.run_cli("add-debit", "live-292", "Unknown merchant", "310.00",
                                    "--due", "2026-11-04", "--account", "cash_app")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        code, out, _ = self.run_cli("digest", "--today", "2026-10-30")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn("Unknown merchant  $310.00  due 2026-11-04 (in 5d)  [Cash App]  NOT COVERED, short $18.00", out)
        self.assertIn("UNCOVERED BILLS", out)
        self.assertIn("PARK FOR GROWTH", out)
        self.assertIn("rate not verified", out)
        # add-debit refuses a missing due date at the CLI layer too
        with contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as cm:
                main(["--db", str(self.path), "add-debit", "x", "M", "1.00", "--account", "cash_app"])
        self.assertEqual(cm.exception.code, 2)  # argparse: --due is required
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli("audit-verify")[0], 0)

    def test_parking_set_rate_roundtrip(self):
        pfile = Path(self.tmp.name) / "parking.json"
        code, _, err = self.run_cli("parking-set-rate", "Cash App Savings", "4.25",
                                    "--source", "https://cash.app/help", "--checked", "2026-10-30",
                                    "--file", str(pfile))
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, err)
        opts = parking.load_options(pfile)
        self.assertEqual(opts[0]["apy_percent"], "4.25")
        code, _, err = self.run_cli("parking-set-rate", "Cash App Savings", "4.25",
                                    "--source", "http://not-official.example", "--checked", "2026-10-30",
                                    "--file", str(pfile))
        self.assertEqual(code, 2)
        self.assertIn("official source", err)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
GENESIS MASTER RUNTIME — the connection layer for the whole fleet.

One terminal entrypoint for Zane and every agent (Cody/OpenCode, Claude,
Astra, Prime, Hermes, ZeroClaw, Glimmer, Kai/Janus) that reads the fleet's
REAL sources of truth — the GHOST job queue, the ACE job-storm registry,
the agent registry — and answers four questions honestly:

    status    Where does everything stand right now?
    board     Same, written to state/BOARD.md (the living board)
    plan      What is dispatchable next, under the WIP cap of 3?
    dispatch  Write a store-and-forward envelope for one job, BY ID
    verify    Which claims have receipts, and which are still unverified?

LAWS ENCODED (not documented — enforced):
  * Grades follow Brandon's ladder: IN BRANDON'S HANDS / LIVE ON A MACHINE /
    BUILT / STAGED / BLOCKED. Nothing here prints DONE except Brandon's
    acceptance, which this tool never asserts.
  * Executor claims sit UNVERIFIED until a receipt file is read back.
  * Registry mutations match deterministic entry IDs ONLY (the 2026-10-31
    mutation law, bought twice). Free-text scans may FIND candidate IDs;
    the write set is always enumerated ID-by-ID and read back in the same run.
  * Human-relay jobs (requires_path = brandon-relay) are NEVER dispatched —
    they are Brandon's hands, not executable work.
  * The runtime writes ONLY inside its own directory (state/, outbox/).
  * Level C is untouched: no money moves, nothing publishes, no account is
    created, no signature is applied, ever, by this tool.
  * A provider 429 is a hard stop for that scope — dispatch envelopes carry
    the fence to the executor; they never retry around one.

Stdlib only. Runs on zane-box, penguin, or S1 unchanged:
    python3 master_runtime.py status|board|plan|verify
    python3 master_runtime.py dispatch GHOST-Q-003
"""

import glob
import json
import os
import socket
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
GENESIS = os.path.dirname(HERE)  # genesis-os/
STATE_DIR = os.path.join(HERE, "state")
OUTBOX_DIR = os.path.join(HERE, "outbox")

LEVEL_C_MARKERS = ("spend", "publish", "payment", "move money", "sign the",
                   "create account", "enroll")

def ghost_jobs(cfg):
    qdir = resolve(cfg["sources"]["ghost_queue_dir"])
    jobs = []
    for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(qdir, "*.json"))):
        job = load_json(path)
        if job and "id" in job:
            jobs.append(job)
    for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(qdir, "Q-*.md"))):
        with open(path) as f:
            head = f.read(600)
        title = next((ln.lstrip("# ").strip() for ln in head.splitlines()
                      if ln.startswith("#")), os.path.basename(path))
        jobs.append({"id": os.path.basename(path).split("-")[0] + "-" +
                     os.path.basename(path).split("-")[1],
                     "title": title, "status": "QUEUED (md work order)",
                     "target_host": "see work order",
                     "requires_path": "see work order",
                     "receipt_target": "per work order §reporting"})
    return jobs

def probes(cfg):
    out = []
    for p in cfg.get("probes", []):
        s = socket.socket()
        s.settimeout(1.5)
        try:
            s.connect((p["host"], p["port"]))
            state = "OPEN"
        except Exception:
            state = "DARK (door unanswered — not proof the service is dead)"
        finally:
            s.close()
        out.append((p["name"], p["host"], p["port"], state))
    return out

def dispatch(cfg, job_id):
    jobs = ghost_jobs(cfg)
    match = [j for j in jobs if j["id"] == job_id]  # by-ID only, per the law
    if not match:
        raise SystemExit(f"REFUSED: no queue entry with exact id {job_id!r}. "
                         "Free-text matches are never dispatched.")
    job = match[0]
    rp = str(job.get("requires_path", ""))
    if "brandon-relay" in rp:
        raise SystemExit(f"REFUSED: {job_id} is a human relay (Brandon's "
                         "hands). The runtime never dispatches those.")
    text = json.dumps(job).lower()
    for marker in LEVEL_C_MARKERS:
        if marker in text and "never" not in text and "no " not in text:
            print(f"WARNING: {job_id} text mentions {marker!r} — envelope "

def parking_comparison(snap: dict, options: list[dict], today: date) -> dict:
    """Ranked comparison. Order: held accounts with a VERIFIED rate (best APY
    first), held STALE, held UNVERIFIED, then non-held in the same order.
    A yearly projection is computed only for a VERIFIED rate on known idle
    cash: idle x APY%, with both inputs shown in the math string."""
    rows = []
    for o in options:
        status = rate_status(o, today)
        idle = _idle_cents(snap, o.get("account_slug"), today)
        projection, math = None, None
        if status == "VERIFIED" and idle is not None:
            projection = int((Decimal(idle) * Decimal(o["apy_percent"]) / Decimal(100)).to_integral_value())
            math = f"{fmt_cents(idle)} idle x {o['apy_percent']}% APY = {fmt_cents(projection)} per year (before tax/fees)"
        rows.append({"name": o["name"], "provider": o.get("provider"), "held": bool(o.get("held")),
                     "account_slug": o.get("account_slug"), "apy_percent": o.get("apy_percent"),
                     "rate_status": status, "rate_source": o.get("rate_source"),
                     "rate_checked": o.get("rate_checked"), "notes": o.get("notes", ""),
                     "idle_cents": idle, "projected_annual_cents": projection, "math": math})
    band = {"VERIFIED": 0, "STALE": 1, "UNVERIFIED": 2}
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (not r["held"], band[r["rate_status"]],
                             -(Decimal(r["apy_percent"]) if r["apy_percent"] else Decimal(-1)), r["name"]))
    verified = [r for r in rows if r["rate_status"] == "VERIFIED"]
    return {"today": today.isoformat(), "rows": rows,
            "best_verified": verified[0]["name"] if verified else None,
            "note": "Rates appear only when recorded from an official source with a check date. "
                    "Genesis does not open accounts or move money; parking anywhere is Brandon's tap in the app."}

def simulate_case(tc, idx, rng):
    """One simulated invoice -> payment -> settlement (+ optional
    dispute/refund) case with exact cent-level expectations."""
    p = GenesisPay(":memory:")
    try:
        amount = rng.randrange(100, 500_001)
        fee = rng.randrange(0, max(1, amount // 20))
        rail = RAILS[idx % len(RAILS)]
        ref = "sim-ref-%d" % idx
        inv_no = "INV-SIM-%04d" % idx
        inv = {"invoice_number": inv_no, "total_cents": amount,
               "currency": "USD", "status": "sent"}
        p.ingest_invoice_issued(inv, "sim-i-%d" % idx)
        pay = p.record_confirmed_payment(
            {"id": idx, "status": "confirmed", "amount_cents": amount,
             "rail": rail, "reference": ref}, inv_no, "sim-p-%d" % idx)
        p.record_settlement(pay["intent_id"], "sim-s-%d" % idx, fee_cents=fee)
        expected_bank = amount - fee
        expected_fees = fee
        mode = idx % 5
        if mode == 3:  # dispute lost for a slice
            loss = rng.randrange(1, max(2, amount // 3))
            d = p.open_dispute(pay["intent_id"], loss, "sim-d-%d" % idx)
            p.resolve_dispute(d["dispute_id"], "lost")
            expected_bank -= loss
            tc.assertEqual(p.account_balance("5300_dispute_losses"), loss)
        elif mode == 4:  # tapped refund of a slice
            refund = rng.randrange(1, max(2, amount // 4))
            req = p.create_tap_request(
                "refund", {"invoice_ref": inv_no, "amount_cents": refund,
                           "currency": "USD", "destination": "client",
                           "intent_id": pay["intent_id"]},
                initiator="zane")
            p.approve_tap_request(req["id"], actor="brandon")
            p.record_refund(req["id"], "sim-r-%d" % idx)
            expected_bank -= refund
        tb = p.trial_balance()
        tc.assertEqual(tb["_total_debits_minus_credits"], 0,
                       "case %d: zero-sum drift" % idx)
        tc.assertEqual(tb["1000_bank_cash"], expected_bank,
                       "case %d: bank balance" % idx)
        tc.assertEqual(tb["5100_processor_fees"], expected_fees)
        tc.assertEqual(tb["1100_accounts_receivable"], 0)
        tc.assertEqual(tb["1200_clearing:%s" % rail], 0)
        tc.assertTrue(p.verify_audit_chain()["valid"])
    finally:
        p.close()

class TestZeroSumEnforcement(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.p = GenesisPay(":memory:")

    def tearDown(self):
        self.p.close()

    def test_api_rejects_unbalanced(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.p.post_journal(
                [{"account": "1100_accounts_receivable", "side": "debit",
                  "amount_cents": 100},
                 {"account": "4000_revenue", "side": "credit",
                  "amount_cents": 99}], "bad", "USD")

    def _raw_entry(self, debit_total, credit_total, line_count):
        self.p._conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO journal_entries (id,created_at,memo,currency,"
            "external_ref_flag,debit_total_cents,credit_total_cents,line_count) "
            "VALUES ('je_raw',datetime('now'),'raw','USD','unmapped_flagged',?,?,?)",
            (debit_total, credit_total, line_count))
        return "je_raw"

    def _raw_line(self, side, amount):
        self.p._conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO journal_lines (entry_id,account_code,side,amount_cents,"
            "currency) VALUES ('je_raw','1000_bank_cash',?,?,'USD')",
            (side, amount))

    def test_trigger_rejects_raw_unbalanced_write(self):
        # Bypass the API entirely: declared totals are equal (100/100) but
        # the actual lines sum 60/40 — the trigger must abort the final line.
        self._raw_entry(100, 100, 2)
        self._raw_line("debit", 60)
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
            self._raw_line("credit", 40)
        self.p._conn.rollback()

    def test_trigger_rejects_lying_declared_totals(self):
        # Lines match their declaration (100/90) but the declaration itself
        # is unbalanced — the trigger checks declared debit == declared credit.
        self._raw_entry(100, 90, 2)
        self._raw_line("debit", 100)
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
            self._raw_line("credit", 90)
        self.p._conn.rollback()

    def test_trigger_accepts_balanced_raw_write(self):
        self._raw_entry(100, 100, 2)
        self._raw_line("debit", 100)
        self._raw_line("credit", 100)  # must not raise
        self.p._conn.rollback()

    def test_trigger_rejects_extra_line_after_completion(self):
        self._raw_entry(100, 100, 2)
        self._raw_line("debit", 100)
        self._raw_line("credit", 100)
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
            self._raw_line("debit", 1)
        self.p._conn.rollback()

    def test_zero_drift_across_mixed_activity(self):
        p = self.p
        for i in range(10):
            amt = 1000 + i * 137
            inv = {"invoice_number": "INV-DRIFT-%d" % i, "total_cents": amt,
                   "currency": "USD", "status": "sent"}
            p.ingest_invoice_issued(inv, "drift-i-%d" % i)
            r = p.record_confirmed_payment(
                {"id": i, "status": "confirmed", "amount_cents": amt,
                 "rail": "cash_app", "reference": "drift-ref-%d" % i},
                inv["invoice_number"], "drift-p-%d" % i)
            p.record_settlement(r["intent_id"], "drift-s-%d" % i,
                                fee_cents=i)
        self.assertEqual(p.trial_balance()["_total_debits_minus_credits"], 0)

def append(entry: dict) -> dict:
    """Append one entry and READ IT BACK from disk before returning it.
    Raises if the read-back does not match what was written."""
    record = {
        "ts": _now_iso(),
        "provider": entry.get("provider"),
        "unit": entry.get("unit"),
        "amount": float(entry.get("amount", 0)),
        "kind": entry.get("kind", "actual"),
        "job": entry.get("job"),
        "note": entry.get("note", ""),
    }
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(LEDGER_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    line = json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True)
    with open(LEDGER_PATH, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    # Read-back verification: the last line on disk must equal what we wrote.
    with open(LEDGER_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        lines = [ln for ln in f.read().splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    if not lines or json.loads(lines[-1]) != record:
        raise RuntimeError("ledger read-back mismatch after append")
    return record

"""Job-spec format + validator for gensdk.

A job spec is a JSON object. Field conventions reuse genesis-os/train's
queue entries where they fit (name ~ job_id/model, est burn, priority,
dataset hash-gate like the Kaggle kernel EXPECTED_CORPUS_SHA discipline).

Required fields:
  name            str, slug ([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-_]*), unique-ish job name
  provider        one of gensdk.PROVIDERS
  entrypoint      kaggle: kernel dir containing kernel-metadata.json
                  colab/modal: local script path
  burn_cap        {"amount": float > 0, "unit": <provider unit>}
                  hard ceiling the run may not exceed; unit must match
                  the provider's unit (gpu_hours/tpu_hours/cu/usd/...)

Optional fields:
  dataset_path    local dataset artifact the run trains on
  dataset_sha256  64-hex SHA-256 of dataset_path. REQUIRED when
                  dataset_path is set (hash gate: a run never trains on
                  an unverified artifact). Verified again at submit time.
  est_burn        expected burn amount (in the provider unit); defaults
                  to burn_cap.amount. Used for quota-fit and lane checks.
  kernel_ref      "owner/slug" for kaggle status/output lookups; filled
                  from kernel-metadata.json at submit time when absent.
  eval_gate       {"description": str,
                   "checks": [{"metric": str, "op": ">="|"<="|">"|"<"|"==",
                                "value": number}, ...]}
                  The post-run bar (e.g. Phoenix: classifier >= 0.90,
                  hallucination <= 0.05). Recorded on the staged/launched
                  record; downstream eval enforces it before serving.
  allow_experimental  bool; required true before the EXPERIMENTAL colab
                  run path will execute anything.
  priority        int (train-queue convention; higher = sooner)
  notes           list[str] or str
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re

from . import PROVIDERS, UNITS

_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-_]*$")
_SHA_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
_OPS = (">=", "<=", ">", "<", "==")

def validate_spec(spec: dict) -> list:
    """Return a list of human-readable errors ([] == valid). Pure shape
    validation; the dataset hash itself is checked by check_hash_gate()."""
    errors = []

    name = spec.get("name")
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not _NAME_RE.match(name):
        errors.append("name: required, must be a slug ([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-_]*)")

    provider = spec.get("provider")
    if provider not in PROVIDERS:
        errors.append(f"provider: required, one of {list(PROVIDERS)}")

    entrypoint = spec.get("entrypoint")
    if not isinstance(entrypoint, str) or not entrypoint:
        errors.append("entrypoint: required (kernel dir or script path)")

    cap = spec.get("burn_cap")
    if not isinstance(cap, dict):
        errors.append("burn_cap: required object {amount, unit}")
    else:
        amount = cap.get("amount")
        if not isinstance(amount, (int, float)) or isinstance(amount, bool) or amount <= 0:
            errors.append("burn_cap.amount: must be a number > 0")
        unit = cap.get("unit")
        if provider in UNITS and unit != UNITS[provider]:
            errors.append(
                f"burn_cap.unit: must be {UNITS[provider]!r} for provider "
                f"{provider!r}, got {unit!r}")

    est = spec.get("est_burn")
    if est is not None:
        if not isinstance(est, (int, float)) or isinstance(est, bool) or est <= 0:
            errors.append("est_burn: must be a number > 0")
        elif isinstance(cap, dict) and isinstance(cap.get("amount"), (int, float)) \
                and est > cap["amount"]:
            errors.append("est_burn: exceeds burn_cap.amount")

    ds_path = spec.get("dataset_path")
    ds_sha = spec.get("dataset_sha256")
    if ds_sha is not None and not (isinstance(ds_sha, str) and _SHA_RE.match(ds_sha.lower())):
        errors.append("dataset_sha256: must be a 64-char lowercase hex SHA-256")
    if ds_path is not None and ds_sha is None:
        errors.append("dataset_sha256: required when dataset_path is set (hash gate)")

    gate = spec.get("eval_gate")
    if gate is not None:
        if not isinstance(gate, dict) or not gate.get("description"):
            errors.append("eval_gate: object with a non-empty description required")
        for i, chk in enumerate(gate.get("checks", []) if isinstance(gate, dict) else []):
            if not isinstance(chk, dict) or not chk.get("metric") \
                    or chk.get("op") not in _OPS \
                    or not isinstance(chk.get("value"), (int, float)):
                errors.append(f"eval_gate.checks[{i}]: needs metric, op in {_OPS}, numeric value")

    if spec.get("allow_experimental") is not None \
            and not isinstance(spec.get("allow_experimental"), bool):
        errors.append("allow_experimental: must be a boolean")

    if spec.get("priority") is not None \
            and not isinstance(spec.get("priority"), int):
        errors.append("priority: must be an integer")

    return errors

def check_hash_gate(spec: dict) -> tuple:
    """Verify dataset_sha256 against dataset_path on disk.

    Returns (ok, message). When no dataset is declared, the gate is
    vacuously satisfied and the message says so."""
    ds_path = spec.get("dataset_path")
    if not ds_path:
        return True, "no dataset declared; hash gate not applicable"
    if not os.path.isfile(ds_path):
        return False, f"dataset_path not found: {ds_path}"
    actual = sha256_file(ds_path)
    expected = str(spec.get("dataset_sha256", "")).lower()
    if actual != expected:
        return False, (f"hash gate FAILED for {ds_path}: sha256 {actual}, "
                       f"spec declares {expected}")
    return True, f"hash gate OK: {ds_path} sha256={actual}"

"""Policy engine — Brandon's training fences, encoded.

Standing law encoded here (sources in README.md):
- FREE LANES AUTO-APPROVED (Brandon's 2026-10-31 order, "GPU training too
  and TPU training — no more taps, automate and maximize"): Kaggle GPU,
  Kaggle TPU, Colab (included compute units), S1-local. This SUPERSEDES
  Rule 6 in custom.legacy-kaggle/CONNECTOR.md and Rule 7 in the local-colab
  skill, both of which required a per-run tap.
- PAID SPEND STAYS FENCED: money beyond included plan credit is Brandon's
  tap. Modal runs are auto-approved ONLY while month-to-date Modal spend
  (per the gensdk ledger) plus this run's cap stays inside the $30/mo
  included credit. Anything past that is refused, not escalated silently.
- TOP-UP PURCHASES ARE NEVER AUTOMATIC: no code path in this SDK buys
  Kaggle/Colab/Modal credit. There is deliberately no purchase function.
- ONE RUN PER LANE AT A TIME: an execute-submit refuses while the lane
  has an active run whose provider status is not terminal.
- SUBMIT WITHOUT --execute ONLY STAGES: writes a staging record, calls
  no provider launch path, burns nothing.
- Quality/eval gates are not taps and are NOT waived by the Oct 31 order:
  the spec's eval_gate travels with the run record and must pass before
  any downstream serving decision.
"""

                     "NOT_RUNNING", "STOPPED")

def approve_execute(spec: dict, provider_status_fn=None) -> tuple:
    """Decide whether an --execute submit may launch.

    provider_status_fn: optional callable(ref) -> status string, used to
    test whether the lane's active run has gone terminal.
    Returns (ok, reason)."""
    provider = spec["provider"]
    cap = float(spec["burn_cap"]["amount"])

    if provider == "lightning":
        return False, ("lightning is NOT_CONNECTED (no credential on file) — "
                       "refusing to launch into a lane that does not exist yet")
    if provider == "local_s1":
        return False, ("local_s1 is TRANSPORT_GATED (fleet tailnet data path; "
                       "Phase B key deposit pending) — staging only")

    if provider == "modal":
        spent = modal_month_spend()
        if spent + cap > MODAL_INCLUDED_CREDIT_USD:
            return False, (f"modal included-credit fence: month-to-date "
                           f"${spent:.2f} + cap ${cap:.2f} exceeds the "
                           f"${MODAL_INCLUDED_CREDIT_USD:.0f}/mo included credit. "
                           "Paid overage is Brandon's tap, never automatic.")

    if provider not in FREE_LANES and provider != "modal":
        return False, f"provider {provider!r} has no auto-approval rule — refusing"

    # One run per lane at a time.
    active = active_run(provider)
    if active:
        status = None
        if provider_status_fn and active.get("ref"):
            try:
                status = provider_status_fn(active["ref"])
            except Exception:
                status = None
        if status and any(t in str(status).upper() for t in TERMINAL_STATUSES):
            clear_active(provider)
        else:
            return False, (f"lane {provider} already has an active run "
                           f"({active.get('job')}, ref={active.get('ref')}, "
                           f"status={status or 'unknown'}) — one run per "
                           "lane at a time")

    lane_note = ("free lane, auto-approved under Brandon's 2026-10-31 order"
                 if provider in FREE_LANES else
                 "modal, inside included credit")
    return True, lane_note

def cmd_submit(args) -> int:
    try:
        spec = jobspec.load_spec(args.spec)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"spec load failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    errors = jobspec.validate_spec(spec)
    if errors:
        for e in errors:
            print(f"INVALID SPEC: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    ok, msg = jobspec.check_hash_gate(spec)
    if not ok:
        print(f"REFUSED: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print(f"hash gate: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)

    if not args.execute:
        record = _stage(spec, args.spec,
                        "no --execute; staging only, nothing launched, nothing burned")
        print(json.dumps(record, indent=2))
        return 0

    provider = get_provider(spec["provider"])

    def status_fn(ref):
        return provider.job_status(ref)

    ok, reason = policy.approve_execute(spec, provider_status_fn=status_fn)
    if not ok:
        print(f"POLICY REFUSAL: {reason}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print(f"policy: APPROVED — {reason}", file=sys.stderr)

    try:
        result = provider.submit(spec)
    except ProviderError as exc:
        print(f"LAUNCH FAILED: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    est = float(spec.get("est_burn", spec["burn_cap"]["amount"]))
    entry = ledger_mod.append({
        "provider": spec["provider"], "unit": UNITS[spec["provider"]],
        "amount": est, "kind": "estimate", "job": spec["name"],
        "note": f"launch estimate; ref={result.get('ref')}; settle with an "
                "'actual' entry when the run completes"})
    policy.mark_active(spec["provider"], {
        "job": spec["name"], "ref": result.get("ref"),
        "launched_at": _now(), "eval_gate": spec.get("eval_gate")})
    print(json.dumps({"launched": True, "provider": spec["provider"],
                      "job": spec["name"], "ref": result.get("ref"),
                      "detail": result.get("detail"),
                      "ledger_estimate": entry}, indent=2))
    return 0

                                 description="Genesis Training SDK CLI")

    sub.add_parser("providers", help="per-provider state").set_defaults(fn=cmd_providers)
    sub.add_parser("quota", help="live quota/balance per provider").set_defaults(fn=cmd_quota)

    p = sub.add_parser("submit", help="stage a job spec (default) or launch it")
    p.add_argument("spec", help="path to the job-spec JSON")
    p.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true",
                   help="actually launch after the policy check; without "
                        "this flag the job is only staged and nothing burns")

    p = sub.add_parser("status", help="active runs and provider status")
    p.add_argument("--provider", default=None)
    p.add_argument("--ref", default=None, help="explicit provider ref to query")
    p.set_defaults(fn=cmd_status)

                   help="append a zero-amount smoke entry (proves append "
                        "+ read-back) before printing totals")
    p.set_defaults(fn=cmd_ledger)

    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    return args.fn(args)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cody brain-lineup qualification harness (2026-10-24).

Runs the standard 3-test battery against one OpenAI-compatible lane/model
and appends one JSON line per test completion to a fragment log.

NEMO law: a model qualifies ONLY if the returned `model` field matches the
requested id (exact or '/'-suffix match). A different model answering =
substitution = recorded as failure evidence.

Usage:
  qualify_harness.py --base http://127.0.0.1:18794/v1 --provider groq \
      --model openai/gpt-oss-120b --cost-class free-tier \
      --out fragments/groq.jsonl [--extra-json '{"reasoning_effort":"high"}'] \
      [--tests T1,T2,T3] [--reasoning-note 'reasoning_effort=high (native)']

Embeddings probe:
  qualify_harness.py --base http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 --provider ollama \
      --model nomic-embed-text --cost-class local --out fragments/mixed.jsonl --embeddings
"""
import argparse, json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, os

MARKER = "LINEUP-T1-OK"

T2_PROMPT = (
    "Write a Python function with exactly this signature: def clamp01(x):\n"
    "It returns 0.0 if x < 0, 1.0 if x > 1, otherwise float(x).\n"
    "Output only the code, no explanation."
)
T3_SNIPPET = (
    "def total(prices):\n"
    "    s = 0\n"
    "    for i in range(len(prices)+1):\n"
    "        s += prices[i]\n"
    "    return s"
)
T3_PROMPT = (
    "This Python function has exactly one bug:\n\n" + T3_SNIPPET + "\n\n"
    "Answer in exactly this format:\nBUG: <what the bug is>\nFIX: <the corrected line>"
)

def curl_post(url, body, timeout=150):
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["curl", "-s", "--noproxy", "*", "-m", str(timeout),
         "-w", "\n%{http_code}", "-H", "Content-Type: application/json",
         "-d", json.dumps(body), url],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    out = p.stdout or ""
    if "\n" in out:
        payload, _, code = out.rpartition("\n")
    else:
        payload, code = out, "000"
    return p.returncode, code.strip(), payload

def check_t3(content):
    c = (content or "").lower()
    named = any(k in c for k in ("off-by-one", "off by one", "indexerror",
                                 "out of range", "out-of-range", "len(prices)+1",
                                 "one too many", "past the end", "last index"))
    fixed = ("range(len(prices))" in c and "+1" not in c.split("range(len(prices))")[0][-0:] ) or \
            ("for p in prices" in c) or ("range(len(prices))" in c and "fix:" in c)
    return (named and fixed), "named=%s fixed=%s" % (named, fixed)

# genesis-os/cody/qualify_harness.py — module (no paired test file in tree) (chunk 7)
def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--base", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--provider", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--model", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--cost-class", default="free-tier")
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--extra-json", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--tests", default="T1,T2,T3")
    ap.add_argument("--reasoning-note", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--embeddings", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    extra = json.loads(a.extra_json) if a.extra_json else {}
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(a.out)), exist_ok=True)
    fout = open(a.out, "a")

    def emit(rec):
        rec.update({"ts": int(time.time()), "provider": a.provider,
                    "lane": a.base, "requested_id": a.model,
                    "cost_class": a.cost_class})
        if a.reasoning_note:
            rec["reasoning_note"] = a.reasoning_note
        fout.write(json.dumps(rec) + "\n")
        fout.flush()
        print(json.dumps({k: rec.get(k) for k in
                          ("test", "pass", "returned_model", "field_match",
                           "latency_ms", "error", "http")}))

    if a.embeddings:
        t0 = time.time()
        rc, code, payload = curl_post(a.base.rstrip("/") + "/embeddings",
                                      {"model": a.model, "input": "lineup probe"})
        lat = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        rec = {"test": "EMB", "latency_ms": lat, "http": code}
        try:
            d = json.loads(payload)
            vec = (d.get("data") or [{}])[0].get("embedding") or []
            rec["pass"] = bool(vec)
            rec["dims"] = len(vec)
            rec["returned_model"] = d.get("model")
        except Exception:
            rec["pass"] = False
            rec["error"] = "BADJSON"
            rec["snippet"] = payload[:160]
        rec["field_match"] = field_match(a.model, rec.get("returned_model"))
        emit(rec)
        return

    prompts = {"T1": "Reply with exactly this text and nothing else: " + MARKER,
               "T2": T2_PROMPT, "T3": T3_PROMPT}
    for t in [x.strip() for x in a.tests.split(",") if x.strip()]:
        r = chat(a.base, a.model, prompts[t], extra)
        if not r["ok"] and r.get("error") in ("TIMEOUT", "CONN"):
            time.sleep(20)
            r = chat(a.base, a.model, prompts[t], extra)
            r["retried"] = True
        if not r["ok"]:
            emit({"test": t, "pass": False, "error": r.get("error"),
                  "http": r.get("http"), "latency_ms": r.get("latency_ms"),
                  "snippet": r.get("snippet", "")})
            if r.get("error") == "HTTP_429":
                emit({"test": "LANE_STOP", "pass": False, "error": "HTTP_429",
                      "note": "stop this provider per rate discipline"})
                return
            continue
        content = r["content"] or ""
        if t == "T1":
            ok = content.strip() == MARKER
            detail = "exact" if ok else "content[:120]=" + content[:120].replace("\n", " ")
        elif t == "T2":
            ok, detail = check_t2(content)
        else:
            ok, detail = check_t3(content)
        fm = field_match(a.model, r.get("returned_model"))
        emit({"test": t, "pass": bool(ok), "detail": detail,
              "returned_model": r.get("returned_model"), "field_match": fm,
              "latency_ms": r.get("latency_ms"), "tokens": r.get("tokens"),
              "http": r.get("http")})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Conductor helper: one recorded lane call for a Cody structured worker.

Usage:
  run_call.py --base http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 --model qwen2.5:1.5b \
      --prompt-file P --out-prefix OUT [--max-tokens 800] [--timeout 300]

Writes OUT.response.json (verbatim API response) and OUT.call.json
({requested_id, returned_model, field_match, latency_ms, http, ts, content}).
Uses curl (this box's egress proxy setup makes urllib unreliable).
No credentials are read or printed by this script; lane proxies hold auth.
"""
import argparse, json, subprocess, sys, time

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--base", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--model", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--prompt-file", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--out-prefix", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=int, default=800)
ap.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=300)
a = ap.parse_args()

prompt = open(a.prompt_file).read()
payload = {"model": a.model,
           "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
           "max_tokens": a.max_tokens, "temperature": 0.2}
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run(
    ["curl", "-s", "--noproxy", "*", "-m", str(a.timeout), "-w", "\n%{http_code}",
     "-X", "POST", a.base.rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions",
     "-H", "Content-Type: application/json", "-d", json.dumps(payload)],
    capture_output=True, text=True)
latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
body, _, http = p.stdout.rpartition("\n")
rec = {"requested_id": a.model, "returned_model": None, "field_match": None,
       "latency_ms": latency_ms, "http": http.strip(), "ts": int(time.time()),
       "content": None}
try:
    resp = json.loads(body)
    open(a.out_prefix + ".response.json", "w").write(json.dumps(resp, indent=1))
    rec["returned_model"] = resp.get("model")
    if rec["returned_model"]:
        rec["field_match"] = ("exact" if rec["returned_model"] == a.model
                              else "mismatch")
    ch = (resp.get("choices") or [{}])[0]
    rec["content"] = ((ch.get("message") or {}).get("content")
                      or ch.get("text"))
    rec["usage"] = resp.get("usage")
except Exception:
    open(a.out_prefix + ".response.raw", "w").write(body)
    rec["detail"] = body[:300]
open(a.out_prefix + ".call.json", "w").write(json.dumps(rec, indent=1))
print(json.dumps({k: rec[k] for k in
                  ("requested_id", "returned_model", "field_match",
                   "latency_ms", "http")}))
sys.exit(0 if rec["field_match"] == "exact" and rec["content"] else 1)
